design_review.notes: 68 guardrails before drafting. runnable_code_check.notes: docs/tutorials/code/world_models_toy.py (pure PyTorch, float64, single thread, seconds): A — single KL (β=9) drives w,d→0, MSE 1; balanced (9/0.1) reaches the analytic fixed point w²=√10−1, d=w/(1+w²), MSE √0.1 within 1e-5, with real .detach() branches; B — shared-encoder JEPA shortcut w_n=0.9^n exactly, stop-grad+EMA teacher stays at 1 with loss 0.5, and stays collapsed from 0 (stop-grad is not an anti-collapse theorem); C — coordinate LAM on a 5×5 gridworld recovers the four transition vectors exactly (val recon 0, purity 1, I(K;A)=2 bits, permutation-invariant). The drafter's independent fixed-point derivation matched the design reviewer's numbers.
